name: Palace of Fine Arts, San Francisco
notes: The exhibition hall is one long curved building. The plan shows its ground floor; a mezzanine walkway with railings runs above parts of it.
North is not marked on the plan. Every reference photo and every new photo carries a compass heading, which fixes orientation.

The Public Entrance is on the inner, concave side of the curve; the Loading Doors are on the outer side; the Theater and Business Entrance are at the east end; the Pavilion and Green Rooms at the west end.

The event setup is not on the plan: bleacher steps with large CAL HACKS letters, sponsor booths with black walls, hacking tables, a food line with 'Now boarding' signs, and 'Destination' signs that name areas such as 'Spacetime Singularity'.
